name: NormalizeColumns
description: Normalize every column name into a database-safe identifier (lowercase, accent-stripped, symbols collapsed to an underscore, truncated to a maximum length, collisions de-duplicated).
usage: Drop it as a ``Transform`` step before a table/database destination. With no parameters it applies safe defaults (lowercase, strip accents, 63-byte max). Use ``overrides`` to pin specific source columns to an exact target name.

attributes.name: max_length
attributes.description: Maximum identifier length. Defaults to 63 (the PostgreSQL identifier byte limit).

attributes.name: replacement
attributes.description: String that replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: overrides
attributes.description: Mapping {original_name: target_name} pinning specific source columns to an exact name, bypassing normalization for those columns.
